title: Zapier vs. MuleSoft comparison: Which is best for your enterprise? [2026]
summary: Here's a full comparison of Zapier and MuleSoft so you can decide which approach fits your enterprise.
body_markdown:
**Zapier**


**MuleSoft**


**Best for**


Businesses that need to give their teams and AI tools instant, governed access to 9,000+


apps


Enterprise IT teams dealing with legacy systems and AI sprawl across multiple platforms


**Ease of use**


Zapier's visual builder, templates, AI copilot, and MCP server make it incredibly straightforward, even for non-technical teams


Only for developers, engineers, and integration architects


**Implementation time**


Minutes to hours


Weeks to months


**Pricing**


Starting at $19.99/month, with team pricing at $69/month; custom pricing available for enterprises


Mid-five figure to six figure licensing fees annually, plus ongoing developer and platform expenses


**Integrations**


9,000+


apps; connections are automatically maintained


~300 prebuilt connectors; manual connector updates required


**Enterprise security**


SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, SSO, audit logging


SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, SSO, audit logging, PCI DSS, HIPAA


**AI capabilities**


Copilot for plain-language workflow building; Zapier MCP gives your AI tools governed access to 9,000+


apps; agentic tool calling built into automations


Agent Fabric for orchestrating and governing agents and other AI assets; MuleSoft Vibes for AI coding; intelligent document processing
